subject: AI brain age gap flags dementia risk years before symptoms
script: From Agewell Brief: AI brain age gap flags dementia risk years before symptoms. A new study in Neurology suggests that the difference between a person's chronological age and their brain's predicted age on MRI could serve as an early warning sign for dementia, catching subtle atrophy that visual rating scales miss. Dementia is a slow, silent thief. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
